engine.scenarioLimit: A scenario is limited to 20 changes.
engine.noTeamForGoal: No team can reach this goal.
engine.noTeamForTarget: No team can reach this target.
engine.simHint: Choose a member and a variant to estimate the collective impact.
engine.def.collectiveCompletionRate: Percentage of released variants owned by at least one active squad member.
engine.def.coveredVariantCount: Number of released and active variants already present in at least one member's collection.
engine.def.totalMissing: Number of released and active variants that no squad member owns.
engine.def.totalUnique: Number of variants owned by exactly one squad member.
engine.def.totalShared: Number of variants owned by at least two squad members.
engine.def.averageOwnershipRate: Average individual ownership rate of active squad members.
engine.def.includedMemberCount: Number of collections shared with the squad and used in calculations.
engine.def.excludedPrivateCollections: Number of private collections excluded from calculations to respect privacy.
engine.def.mostComplementaryMember: Member bringing the most variants that other squad members don't own.
engine.def.missingAll: Variants that nobody in the squad owns.
engine.def.uniqueOwner: Variants owned by only one squad member.
engine.def.duplicates: Variants owned by at least two squad members.
engine.def.availableNow: Variants currently available in the game.
engine.def.priorities: Variants deemed a priority by the collective acquisition engine.
engine.def.bestPair: Pair of members covering the most variants together.
engine.def.bestTeam: Group of 2 to 4 members covering the most variants together.
engine.def.minimumTeam: Minimum number of members needed to reach the chosen coverage target.
engine.def.simulation: Temporary scenario: it never modifies real collections.
engine.communityPeerProgress: Comparable squads ({band}) gain {points} point{s} per week on average.
engine.communityDisclaimer: Data from the sprite-index community — not a leaderboard.
engine.hint.combinations: Compare groups of 2, 3 or 4 members with the best collective coverage.
engine.hint.minimumTeam: Find the smallest number of members needed to reach a coverage target.
engine.hint.simulation: Add multiple acquisitions, a member joining, or a member leaving, then simulate the whole scenario without modifying real collections.
engine.communityContextHint: Anonymous benchmarks among similarly sized squads — no ranking.
engine.priorityHint: Deterministic distribution of high-impact searches among visible members.
